headline: Chip Stocks Turn Higher by Lunch

writeup.headline: Chip Stocks Turn Higher by Lunch
writeup.summary: This morning's big story was Nvidia Slide Deepens as Huang-Return Talk Swirls. The big swing: chip stocks slid early, then turned around after 10:36 AM and are now higher on the day — MarketWatch points to “These 13 S&P 500 stocks can rise up to 70% over the next year, according to analysts”. The AI names are down and the average stock is down: stocks are moving together. Cyclical sectors are leading defensive ones, and the S&P has stayed under pressure.

themes.headline: Chip stocks climbed back from an early slide
themes.detail: Down 5.0% at 10:36 AM, now -3.5%; biggest gainers since: Broadcom, TSMC. In the news: “These 13 S&P 500 stocks can rise up to 70% over the next year, according to analysts” (MarketWatch).

themes.headline: S&P has stayed under pressure
themes.detail: Low at 10:25 AM, high at 9:38 AM; -0.5% since the open.
